claim: The new reportDiagnostic wrapper (ReportIfLocatedInCompilation) drops every diagnostic whose location is not in a source tree of the current compilation, including Location.None. Diagnostics with no location, or located in generated or other trees, are silently suppressed. This could hide diagnostics that protect against insecure or unsupported configurations (e.g. MsgPack004/005 on a member with null or metadata location). In the same-assembly case where a location lookup returns null (e.g. the property is not a PropertyDeclarationSyntax), the diagnostic is now discarded rather than reported. The security impact is limited because it only applies to compile-time diagnostics and the dropped cases involve referenced-assembly types, which L8 says are deliberately not analysed.
